# Hardtland Home Improvement, Inc.

> Family-owned roofing contractor in Madison, Wisconsin, founded in 1972 by Tom Degenhardt. CertainTeed Master Shingler and Owens Corning Certified. Roof replacement, roof repair, hail and storm damage, insurance claim help, metal roofing, siding, gutters, windows and doors for Madison, Verona, Fitchburg, Middleton, Oregon, Mount Horeb and Dane, Green and Rock counties.

- Phone (call or text): (608) 575-9317
- Email: tomd@tds.net
- Address: 5821 Thrush Ln, Madison, WI 53711
- Free roof and exterior inspections; works with all insurance companies
- Payment: insurance, personal checks, cash, Zelle

## Services

- [Free Roof Inspection in Madison & Verona](https://www.hardtlandhomeimprovement.com/free-roof-inspection/): Book a free, no-pressure roof inspection. Photos of what we find and an honest repair-or-replace answer.
- [Siding Contractor in Madison, WI](https://www.hardtlandhomeimprovement.com/siding/): Siding replacement and repair, plus soffit and fascia, for Madison-area homes. Free estimate from a local contractor since 1972.
- [Gutters & Gutter Guards in Madison, WI](https://www.hardtlandhomeimprovement.com/gutters/): Seamless gutters, leaf guards and gutter repair for Madison, Verona and Fitchburg homes. Free estimate.
- [Window & Door Replacement in Madison, WI](https://www.hardtlandhomeimprovement.com/windows-doors/): Energy-efficient replacement windows and entry doors, installed by a local Madison contractor. Free in-home estimate.
